prepare_dataset_from_tsv: prepare a knowledge graph dataset by mapping entities and relations to unique IDs from tab-separated train, valid, test files
run_dataset_preparation: run the script to prepare FB15K, WN, WN18RR, FB237, and YAGO3-10 datasets from source TSV files
create_entity_relation_mappings: create entity-to-ID and relation-to-ID mappings from tab-separated knowledge graph triplet files
generate_filtering_lists: generate to_skip filtering lists for filtered evaluation metrics on left-hand and right-hand side entities
compute_entity_probabilities: compute and save entity frequency probability distributions for lhs, rhs, and both sides of training triples
